Summary: 
Billionaire Elon Musk has reportedly abandoned his plans to form a new political party, according to a US newspaper. However, according to the Wall Street Journal, Musk has since focused on maintaining relationships with Vice President JD Vance and has admitted to his close associates that forming a political party would harm his relationship with Vance. Musk also warned that Tesla will face a challenging period in the coming quarters following the end of the Trump administration's support for electric vehicles. Investors are concerned about whether Musk will have enough time and attention to devote to Tesla, given his plans to form a new political party.
